title: Implement, gradient-check and audit a local detector
promptMarkdown: Write a complete standard-library valid1D cross-correlation forx=(1,3,2,0), w=(1,−1), upstreamg=(2,−1,3). Derive analyticdx, dw, verify each coordinate with central finite differencesε=10⁻⁶ onL=g·y, and report maximum errors. Add a test of linearity inx and a deliberate nonzero-bias counterexample. Finally propose a fair experiment comparing this shared-kernel architecture with a dense model on new independent signals: define split units, an appropriate baseline, validation choices, shift/boundary tests and what would count against the convolutional assumption.
hintLadder: Checkg·y as a scalar so finite differences have an unambiguous target.
Accumulate through every overlapping receptive field.
Test architectural assumptions with signals that differ in exactly the information the model may discard.
